_about: The six styles of workflow 2 (atlas/ALIEN.md 8.2), as the ideas and script stages read them. ids match _shell/styles.json. buildable: the engine draws its whole spine today and film.py has its builder; a style that is not buildable is never offered, so nothing is faked. Every buildable style is made of studio recordings (studio.py): what the product itself returned for a typed sentence.

styles.name: Reading Wipe Before/After
styles.look: A page: the upload, whole and wide, and the one sentence that was typed. A leaning caret reads the sentence, and the caret is the seam of the before/after: everything it has passed is already the film the product made. The sentence is spent as it is read. Then that film, untouched; then the upload and the film side by side at the same instant, with one line and the edit's facts.
styles.hook: Frame 0 is the raw upload, the sentence and the caret. By 0.5 s the frame is changing behind the caret.
styles.close: A keyword drawn in static that only reads while it moves, with the product's mark kept clear.
styles.needs: one recording where one sentence was typed before the first result and a vertical film came back; the sentence short enough for one line
styles.cta: a keyword of 4 to 7 letters that only exists in motion (A1), on its own for about 3 s before the end card

styles.name: It Edits Itself
styles.look: The first cut plays, then the frame pulls back onto its own timeline: every block a kept range of the project's EDL at its true second, the playhead at the true time. A sentence is typed. The blocks it removed are marked and leave, the rest close up, the pictures it added land, and the frame goes back into the new cut.
styles.hook: Frame 0 is the first cut; within two seconds it is a viewer above its own timeline.
styles.close: The edit's receipt prints: what was typed, what was cut, what was added, the EDL versions.
styles.needs: one recording with an export before a typed sentence and an export after it, and the EDL of both
styles.cta: a keyword on the last line of the receipt (A3)

styles.name: One Clip, Three Films
styles.look: Three films of the same instant side by side, lips moving together: three edits the product made of one upload from three typed sentences. Then each sentence typed and its film whole, the same seconds each time. Then the three again.
styles.hook: Frame 0 is the three films at once, the same word on three mouths.
styles.close: The three again, with a question: which one would you post.
styles.needs: three recordings of one upload with three different typed sentences, each a vertical film that keeps the same few seconds whole
styles.cta: a question and a number to comment (1, 2 or 3); nothing to send

styles.name: Silent Film, Hidden Word
styles.look: No voice. An effects film at 17-28 cuts per 10 s with one long breath, ending on the pause-proof keyword.
styles.needs: weave and glyph junctions between real exports; a sound plan without a bed

styles.name: Exploded
styles.look: Time stops and the frame comes apart into its real layers with real values.

styles.name: Did You Notice
styles.look: A plain talk to lens; the room changes six times in blinks; rewind, replay.
styles.needs: matte, clean plate and blink times (class B)
